Hi Lara / Sean,

Thanks for the heads-up. I took a quick look at the sample lines in the report and reproduced the pattern in a staging job. High-level remediation and evidence plan below.

What we did so far (hours):
- Confirmed reproduction in staging and identified the error handler path that logs exception context containing the ephemeral DB token (ticket: JIRA-4823).
- Implemented a logging scrubber that runs at the emitter layer (filters and redacts hex-like tokens and "password=" patterns). Rollout to staging scheduled for 2027-03-04 09:00 PT.

Planned full fix (next sprint):
1) Update credential issuance so workers receive only short-lived opaque references, not creds; changes in repo infra/creds-manager, PR #9422 (branch: fix/log-redaction-9422).
2) Update error handling to avoid serializing credential objects in logs.
3) Add unit and integration tests to validate redaction rules.
4) Rotate any credentials that matched the exposed pattern and invalidate sessions where applicable.

Evidence we will provide: 
- audit-log-sample.txt (sanitized before sharing)
- remediation-rollout-plan.md (detailed steps, roll-forward/rollback, verification checklist)
- PR link and commit id (will include diff that removes token exposure)
- Change execution timeline and deployment tags

Preliminary ETA: scrubber in staging 2027-03-04; PR opened by 2027-03-05; remediation validated in staging 2027-03-07; evidence package ready by 2027-03-09 17:00 PT. If Acme needs the redacted log sample earlier, we can extract and sanitize a sample by EOD 2027-03-03.

Attachments (to be generated): audit-log-sample.txt, remediation-rollout-plan.md
